verdict.rationale: Adyen documents first-party APIs for running parts of risk management programmatically without the UI. The Referrals API automates uploading block and trust lists, and the Disputes API retrieves, defends or accepts disputes. Published OpenAPI definitions support scripted use, but core risk-profile configuration and case review are documented only through the Customer Area UI. missing for 10: a CLI or documented CI/CD integration, API-driven management of risk profiles and rules, and independent hands-on evidence of headless automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: You can use our Referrals API to automate uploading lists of referrals and referral details to block and trust lists.
You can retrieve dispute information, defend or accept disputes, and upload defense documents.
